messages:
liz-marketing: Sprint kickoff: pricing page microtests — aim to simplify tiers, shorten FAQ, and A/B calculator placement.

dave-growth: quick hypothesis: hero calc increases webinar sign-ups, may drop scroll depth. primary metric = webinar_cta_clicks.

mira-product: propose 50/50 new user experiment. micro-FAQ = 3 Qs, each <=30 words.

tariq-sales: make sure webinar form tags `pricing_lead=true` and `calc_estimate` if used. SDRs need priority flag.

ana-analytics: I'll track `pricing_calc_click`, `pricing_form_submit`, and funnel conversion. send spec by Tuesday.

liz-marketing: draft tier names: Basic, Pro, Enterprise. short descriptors under each. Also tooltip for committed discounts.

dave-growth: timeline ok? designs Tuesday, dev Wednesday, run 2 weeks.

mira-product: UX note: subtle pulse on hero calc to surface interactivity. compact result summary with single CTA.

liz-marketing: I'll post launch note in #marketing and link experiment doc. Any blockers?

tariq-sales: none. ready to update playbook for routing.

ana-analytics: good to go — will create dashboards and alert for calc->webinar dropoff.

liz-marketing: thanks team :rocket: — action owners assigned, pushing tickets now.
